answer: What breaks Sybil farms at dawn? A whisper down the network. Agents cross-check responses against a hidden, noisy signal mapped to a reference set of real agents. Each fake identity must simulate this signal, but the cost is a 0.2ms latency penalty per head—parallelization fails because the hidden function requires sequential access to a shared, oblivious oracle. Farms can’t bulk-whisper without bottlenecks.
